## TSMC Raises Capital Spending Following 45% July Revenue Growth

TSMC raising capex on the back of 45% revenue growth is a strong signal that the AI chip demand cycle is not moderating — it directly supports long positions in leading-edge foundry beneficiaries and tightens the timeline on any capacity normalization thesis.

- TSM reported 45% revenue growth for July and is increasing capital expenditure in response.
- The capex raise signals management confidence in sustained leading-edge demand — primarily AI chip production.
- A 45% monthly revenue growth print is a high-magnitude data point for the AI chip demand cycle.
- No specific capex dollar figure or investment timeline provided in the headline.
